instruction: Compare iPhone 15 Pro with iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 13 Pro on Apple's website

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing three iPhone Pro models. Agent needs to navigate to Apple Compare page and select iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 14 Pro, and iPhone 13 Pro. The evaluator parses the URL query parameter 'modelList' and verifies it contains the three specified models in any order.
metadata.verification: Similar task to original - comparing 3 iPhone Pro models instead of Pro Max models. Uses identical evaluator structure with different model names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction to compare three specific iPhone models on Apple's website
Getter (active_tab_url_parse) appropriately extracts the 'modelList' query parameter from the active tab URL
The 'split_list: true' configuration correctly splits the comma-separated modelList into an array for comparison
Metric (check_direct_json_object) properly compares the extracted modelList against the expected three models
The 'ignore_list_order: true' setting is semantically correct - the instruction doesn't specify which order the models should be compared in
All instruction requirements are verified: (1) comparing three specific iPhone models, (2) on Apple's website (implicitly validated by URL structure)
The goto_prefix 'https://www.' matches Apple's URL structure
Error handling is appropriate - if modelList parameter is missing, getter returns None, causing evaluation to fail (correct behavior)
